name: Sow
overview: The biblical concept of sowing, as illustrated in Genesis 8:22 and Galatians 6:7-8, emphasizes the consistent and unchanging principles God has established in creation and human life. Just as the earth reliably produces seedtime and harvest, so too does God ensure that the actions we sow—whether to the flesh or to the Spirit—result in corresponding outcomes. Sowing to the flesh leads to corruption, while sowing to the Spirit yields eternal life, underscoring the moral and spiritual law of reaping what one sows.
